stories.title: North Clwyd Animal Rescue closes for a week after puppies fall ill
stories.summary: North Clwyd Animal Rescue is to close for a week as a precaution, after a litter of puppies from the Mostyn area became unwell. stories.title: Shotton railway station to get new Transport for Wales Help Point
stories.summary: Shotton railway station is to get a new Help Point, Transport for Wales has confirmed. It is one of 48 stations across Wales sharing in a £1 million investment to install the devices, which connect passengers directly to a Customer Information Controller at the press of a button. stories.title: Motorists have been warned to avoid Liverpool Road in Buckley after reports of flooding
stories.summary: Motorists have been warned to avoid Liverpool Road in Buckley after reports of flooding. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team issued the warning on Facebook at 5.21am. stories.title: Flint councillor warns of HMO “unwelcome precedent” as officers recommend approval
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council officers have recommended approval for a plan to turn a three-bedroom house in Flint into a four-person house in multiple occupation, known as an HMO. stories.title: iking boots to stand-up: Outdoor boss from Flintshire swaps the great outdoors for the comedy stage
stories.summary: A outdoor centre boss from Flintshire is swapping hiking boots for a microphone after taking up stand-up comedy just two years ago.
